title: The pricing pages show four Space plans with Network, the Collective or Network graphics, and a Networks page

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-15/16: redesign every marketing tier and page around the new Network tier, with simple infographics in the design system. PR 3 of 6, the marketing step.

detail: spaceOfferings adds a quoted Network card after the advertised ladder (QUOTED_SPACE_PLANS in lib/pricing/display.ts): price 'from' NETWORK_PLAN.monthlyCents, the chapter allowance and non profit price in its billing line, its 2% fee from the take-rate ladder, and a Talk to us button to /networks while networkCheckoutOpen is false. Collective's copy moves to separate groups that partner. pricingTiers, the page-editor pricing template, the FAQ (a Collective or Network question) and the help center (content/help/spaces/network.md, collective.md, plans-and-pricing.md) follow. The Frequency pricing page gains a Collective or Network section with three inline SVG graphics (components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/tier-graphics.tsx: the tier ladder, Collective or Network, the fee bars) drawn in currentColor with the kit's tokens, and every figure read from the offerings. /networks is a new Frequency-only page (like /vision) with the who-sees-what graphic, what Network includes and its price, listed in the sitemap under Frequency.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const g=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/pricing-grid.ts','utf8');const d=fs.readFileSync('lib/pricing/display.ts','utf8');const p=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/pages/pricing/frequency-pricing.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(!d.includes(\"QUOTED_SPACE_PLANS = ['network']\"))bad.push('Network is not on the public ladder');if(!g.includes('networkOffering('))bad.push('no Network card');if(!p.includes('<TierLadder')||!p.includes('<CollectiveOrNetwork')||!p.includes('<FeeBars'))bad.push('pricing page has no tier graphics');if(!fs.existsSync('app/(marketing)/networks/page.tsx'))bad.push('no Networks page');if(!fs.existsSync('content/help/spaces/network.md'))bad.push('no Network help article');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-961: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
